features.f: A tall, slender, long-legged woman with two long rabbit ears standing straight up from the top of the head, each about as tall as the head itself, narrow and gently tapered to soft points, covered in short fur the same colour as her hair (they change colour with the hair), with pale pink inner skin and a fluffy fur tuft where each ear meets the head. A mature, sharp-featured face with almond eyes and full lips, ordinary small human ears are absent, and she stands on the balls of her feet with the heels raised, as if always in high heels.
features.m: A tall, lean, athletic man (on average a little shorter than Viera women) with two long rabbit ears rising from the top of the head and leaning slightly outward in a V, somewhat shorter and shaggier than the women's, furred in the same colour as his hair with pale pink insides and fluffy fur tufts at the base. An angular face with a sharp brow and narrow eyes, no small human ears, and he too stands on raised heels on the balls of his feet.

f.desc: A black, Fran-style armoured outfit: a cropped long-sleeved black bolero with a tiny red zigzag trim at the elbows over a black metal bustier engraved with swirls, a sheer smoky panel down the bare middle and a short sheer lace-edged apron hanging in front of a high-cut black bottom, a thin black choker and flared black engraved bracers on the forearms. The legs wear black openwork engraved armour from mid-thigh to ankle, ending in high-heeled black sandals with claw-like toe caps.

m.desc: A dark ranger's outfit: a cropped black top with ragged strapped short sleeves and a bare midriff, a draped black cowl and choker at the neck, one ornate silver pauldron on one shoulder and a black strap with a big silver ring buckle running diagonally across the chest, over a cream fringed hip wrap and baggy dark brown breeches belted with two crossed brown leather belts studded with turquoise stones and hung with small pouches. Engraved silver bracers over black fingerless gloves, and tall engraved silver greaves up to the knee ending in silver sabatons with claw-like toes.

notes: Creator data: CharaMakeType rows 28/29 (Rava m/f) and 30/31 (Veena m/f); Gender 0 is male, 1 is female. The hairstyle menu (Lobby 234) holds 52 entries for each gender, identical for both clans, so the list is given once. Every listed CharaMakeCustomize row has IsPurchasable=false and no unlock item (the purchasable Modern Aesthetics rows, e.g. row 2181, are not in the menu), so all 52 are free at creation. fid 1-17 are Viera-only styles; fid 102+ are styles shared with other races, re-modelled around the ears. Icons only show the front three-quarter view, so backs of ponytails, buns and braids are inferred. Ears: in game the ear fur takes the hair colour (official screenshots show blonde, pink, white and black ears matching the hair), with pale pink inner skin; gen-race.mjs's viera 'bald' note says skin-coloured ears, which does not match the game. Every hairstyle shows the same fluffy fur tufts at the ear bases. The creator also offers 4 ear shapes (upright, tall tufted, lop ears drooping sideways, smooth pointed) and an ear-length slider. Viera have no small human ears; their faces are framed by hair only. Heights: in-game ranges are body height without ears (same for both clans); female Viera are taller than male Viera. The with-ears figures are my estimates measured from official full-body renders (ears add roughly 30-37 cm for women and 22-28 cm for men at default ear length), not official numbers. scale = typical height without ears / 90 cm. Starter outfit: CharaMakeType.Equipment[0] for these rows is model 0744 (male) and 0581 (female) on body, hands, legs and feet, which are the Viera racial items listed (Race sheet RSE* fields); the same for both clans. The female set (patch 5.0) is modelled on Fran from FFXII and is revealing; for a small chibi it reads as a black long-sleeved crop top and engraved corset, black bracers and black thigh-high armoured stockings with heels. The female 'sheer smoky panel' and 'lace apron' are translucent in game. The male set was added in 6.0. Skins: from human.cmp via xivdyetools' extracted palette (192 swatches per clan and gender). Rava palettes are mid to very dark browns (lightest #9A705D), Veena palettes are peach to pale cream with some rosy/grey rows; the eight swatches skip the mauve and grey rows. Each clan's male and female palettes are nearly identical (a few swatches differ slightly). Uncertain details: the colour of the m05 ribbon (reads white with blue shading in the icon), whether the dark stripes in f39's drill curls are a wound ribbon, and whether f32 has a ribbon (a dark blue-grey strip behind the hair was treated as shading). f17 Fran's Mask, m09 Filigree Circlet and m17 Filigree Helm left out (2026-10-02): headgear, not hair; the hair overlay keeps hair only, so they came apart (bare scalp, a face on the back of the head).
sources: https://v2.xivapi.com/api/asset?path=ui/icon/138000/138201_hr1.tex&format=png (and the other hair, ear and item icons)
